'''G-Rex''' was a [[:Category:Taiwan|Taiwanese]] esports organization. They intially entered the [[LMS/Spring/2018|LMS]] on September 15th, 2017 with acquisation of the spot of [[Raise Gaming]]. <ref name="【LMS 職業聯賽】聯盟公告：英皇電競動力接手 RG 2018 春季賽經營權">{{cite web|url=http://lms.garena.tw/news/content/3132|date=2017-09-15|title=【LMS 職業聯賽】聯盟公告：英皇電競動力接手 RG 2018 春季賽經營權|publisher=Garena.tw|language={{Flag|tw}} }}</ref>
On February 13th, 2020 '''G-Rex's''' parent company '''Emperor Esports''' announces the disbandment of '''G-Rex'''. <ref name="G-Rex DISBAND">{{cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/eesstars/posts/483173635705407|title=G-Rex Gaming自2017年成立起，獵人們走過高峰亦跌進過低谷，曾經在戰場上打敗不同的敵人。這陣子G-Rex遇上了更兇險的挑戰，突如其來不明朗的經濟環境所帶來的嚴峻壓力及影響，讓我們不得不重新思考部署。|date=2020-02-13 |author=[[G-Rex]]|language={{Flag|cn}}}}</ref>
